Bug_Title: SING: Class using singleton design pattern directly implements Cloneable interface. (SING_SINGLETON_IMPLEMENTS_CLONEABLE)
Bug_Details:
If a class using singleton design pattern directly implements the Cloneable interface, it is possible to create a copy of the object, thus violating the singleton pattern.
Therefore, implementing the Cloneable interface should be avoided.

For more information, see: SEI CERT MSC07-J.
Bug_Explanation: Singleton class directly implements Cloneable interface. This violates the singleton pattern as it allows for the creation of multiple instances of the class.
Trigger_Explanation: If a class using singleton design pattern directly implements the Cloneable interface, it is possible to create a copy of the object, thus violating the singleton pattern.

This violates the singleton pattern, as it allows for multiple instances of the Singleton class to be created.
